localOnly.title: Stored locally
localOnly.description: Repository details, paths, and operation logs stay on this Mac.

workspaces.subtitle: Create, manage, and open isolated multi-repository workspaces

repositories.subtitle: Manage the Git repositories available to new workspaces

settings.subtitle: Manage the interface language and default locations for new workspaces

confirmDialog.localFilesPreserved: No local files or folders will be deleted.

createWorkspace.title: Create workspace
createWorkspace.description: ReqWS clones each selected repository into an isolated directory and switches them to the same feature branch.

name.label: Workspace name
name.help: Used to generate the default folder and .code-workspace file names.

branch.label: Feature branch
branch.help: If the branch exists on the remote, ReqWS tracks it. Otherwise, it creates the branch from each repository’s default branch.

rootPath.label: Workspace code folder
rootPath.help: After you choose a parent folder, ReqWS generates the final path from the workspace name. You can also enter an absolute path.

rules.title: How creation works:
rules.description: Selected repositories are cloned one at a time. If any step fails, ReqWS cleans up temporary files and does not save an incomplete workspace. It never pushes automatically or shares Git metadata between repositories.

createWorkspace.directoryUnavailable: The previously selected folder no longer exists or cannot be accessed. Choose another folder.

inUse.label: In use
inUse.description: Used by at least one workspace

git.unavailable: Not detected; Git operations are unavailable

repositories.gitUnavailable: Git was not found. You can still edit the repository list, but connection tests, workspace creation, and adding repositories to workspaces are unavailable.

search.label: Search repositories
search.placeholder: Search by name, Git URL, or default branch…

noMatches.title: No matching repositories
noMatches.description: Try a repository name, Git URL, or default branch.

initial.title: No repositories yet
initial.description: Add a repository to make it available when creating workspaces.

repositoryDialog.description: Saving stores the repository settings; it does not clone the repository. You can save even if the connection test fails.

url.label: Git repository URL
url.help: Supports credential-free HTTPS and SSH URLs. The name is filled from the URL when you add a repository.

repositoryDialog.name: Name
repositoryDialog.gitUnavailable: Git was not found, so connection testing is unavailable. You can still save the repository settings.

test.failureDoesNotBlockSave: A failed connection test does not prevent saving.

repositoryDialog.editWarning: Changing the URL or default branch does not update repositories in existing workspaces.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Code folders and workspace files are available

search.label: Search workspaces
search.placeholder: Search by name, branch, repository, or path…

noMatches.title: No matching workspaces
noMatches.description: Try a name, branch, repository, or path.

initial.title: No workspaces yet
initial.description: Select at least one repository to create your first isolated workspace.

workspaceDetail.editorDisabledPathIncomplete: The workspace paths are incomplete, so it cannot be opened in an editor.
workspaceDetail.pathsMissing: Some workspace paths or files no longer exist.
workspaceDetail.statusError: This workspace currently has an error.
workspaceDetail.managedFileNotice: ReqWS manages this .code-workspace file. Adding, removing, or syncing repositories regenerates the file and overwrites manual changes.

repositories.removeNotice: Removing a repository from the workspace only updates its manifest and .code-workspace file. It does not delete the local repository folder.

forget.title: Remove workspace record
forget.description: This only removes the record from the ReqWS workspace list. The code folder, workspace manifest, and .code-workspace file remain on disk.

operation.description: Keep ReqWS open until the operation finishes. Other Git operations are unavailable in the meantime.

stages.rolling-back: Safely cleaning up the incomplete operation…

rollbackReasons.CLEANING_STAGING: Creation failed. Cleaning up temporary files that were not published…
rollbackReasons.RETAINING_PUBLISHED_ARTIFACTS: Creation failed. Generated folders and files were retained to avoid accidental deletion.

settings.title: Settings

workspaceParentDirectory.label: Default workspace parent folder
workspaceParentDirectory.description: New workspaces are created in this folder by default.

workspaceFileDirectory.label: .code-workspace file folder
workspaceFileDirectory.description: Generated .code-workspace files are stored here by default.

settings.directoryUnavailable: The previously selected folder no longer exists or cannot be accessed. Choose another folder.

toasts.workspaceRecordRemoved: Removed “{{name}}” from ReqWS. Files on disk were not deleted.

toasts.openedCursorRoot: Opened the code folder in Cursor.

removeRepository.referenced: “{{name}}” is still used by these workspaces: {{workspaces}}. Deleting the record does not change existing workspaces or delete local clones.
removeRepository.unreferenced: Deleting the record does not delete any local clones.

removeWorkspaceRepository.title: Remove “{{name}}” from the workspace?
removeWorkspaceRepository.description: ReqWS updates the workspace manifest and .code-workspace file, but does not delete the local repository folder.

forgetWorkspace.title: Remove workspace record “{{name}}”?
forgetWorkspace.description: This only removes the record from the ReqWS workspace list. The code folder, workspace manifest, and .code-workspace file are preserved.
